ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio featuring a light-grey to off-white primary surface (approx. 70%) with high-intensity black borders and internal mottling (approx. 30%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation along the trailing edge. Left lobe exhibits dense, irregular black mottling concentrated near the notch and lower boundary. Right lobe features two distinct, dark, parallel curvilinear marks in the upper-mid region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped median notch with an approximate 110-degree pixel angle and moderate depth relative to the fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency, low-to-medium amplitude serrations. The left lobe displays more jagged, peak-like variations compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a concave upward sweep trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast brownish-yellow and black pixel aggregates localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two dark, unaligned, parallel curved linear marks on the right lobe surface, oriented vertically.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions and brownish-yellow growths (likely parasitic colonization) at the distal tips of both lobes, with the left tip showing a larger, more complex mass.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronest yellowish-brown discoloration on the lateral margins, deviating from standard monochromatic pigmentation patterns.
